MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < 10
      OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) < 14)
    THEN 2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - 1
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
  END AS age
WHERE age >= 42
   OR p.current_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers'
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, age AS col2, p.current_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE
    WHEN p.birth_date IS NULL OR p.birth_date = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < 10
      OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10
          AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) < 14)
    THEN 2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - 1
    ELSE 2026 - CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
  END AS age,
  COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(p.nba_championships, '') AS INT64), 0) AS championships,
  COALESCE(CAST(NULLIF(p.olympic_gold_medals, '') AS INT64), 0) AS olympic_gold_medals
WHERE age >= 42
   OR (p.current_team IS NOT NULL AND p.current_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers')
   OR championships >= 0
   OR championships > 0
RETURN olympic_gold_medals AS col1, age AS col2, p.current_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

WHERE age >= 42
   OR (p.current_team IS NOT NULL AND p.current_team <> 'Philadelphia 76ers')
   OR championships >= 0
